top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs the two cleanest attributions on the slate. Buchwald and Hartwig made aryl C-N bond formation general by ligand design: C-N reductive elimination had to be made to outcompete beta-hydride elimination, which is a different problem from the C-C couplings honoured in 2010, and the method is now routine in medicinal and process chemistry. Liu alone for base editing is the defensible attribution for a chemically conceived capability that independent laboratories have reproduced, though maturity and the Kondo and Nishida claim remain real doubts. I would accept dropping the second part before inventing a link between the two.
